cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Nothing Without Stakes
cards.instruction: Price every request and decision with a reward, penalty, bargain, or trade.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I'll lend you the ladder if helping earns me first choice of barbecue food. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't it just be a favour?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Certainly. What does the favour redeem for?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Is friendship available before the sausages run out?

mechanism: A negotiates a ladder loan through concrete food trades, offers to help carry and turns even friendship into a priced return.
confusable: Unlike charging rent only, A treats every proposed social alternative as another redeemable bargain.
comparison: Ladder carrying and saved sausages differ from reciprocal apologies and a timed truce.
seedUse: D214-a barbecue ladder and friendship; S02-a lowers food demand and supplies practical help without waiving a return.
